aiOverview.content: Yes, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is alive and well. Following widespread, unverified rumors on social media and claims from Iranian-linked media suggesting he had been killed or injured in an attack, Netanyahu's office dismissed the reports as "fake news". Key updates as of March 15–16, 2026: Video Evidence: Netanyahu posted a video on X (formerly Twitter) showing himself at a café to mock the rumors, stating, "They say I'm what?". Addressing Rumors: He directly addressed "six-finger" conspiracy theories—which claimed a previous video of him was AI-generated—by showing his hands to the camera to prove the allegations were false. Official Confirmation: Official sources confirmed he is in Jerusalem, continuing to lead the country during the ongoing conflict. The false rumors gained traction amidst high-intensity conflict between Israel and Iran.
